kindHelp.primary: A record made by the people or organisation involved, or an official filing or dataset.
kindHelp.tertiary: A general reference work (such as an encyclopedia) that summarises other sources.

STRATEGY.focus: Asymmetric advantage, choosing the battlefield, mergers, and outmanoeuvring entrenched rivals.

OPERATIONS.focus: Supply chains, bottlenecks, standardisation, speed and complex physical systems.

principles.builtInNote: Every built-in principle is summarised in BIZSIM's own words with attribution; no passages are reproduced. Your own principles stay on this device and travel with QR transfer.

data: Wikidata (CC0) and Wikipedia (CC BY-SA) for company profiles
U.S. SEC EDGAR for audited financials and filings
Google News, Bing News or GDELT for recent headlines (links only)
Wikipedia and Wikimedia Commons for each season's own lead image, free licences only (credited on use)
Piper open-source voice engine with public-domain / CC0 male voices
Optional: Gemini or OpenAI image generation, always labelled as AI

keys.intro: Optional. All 200 seasons play without a key. A key adds AI live seasons, the chat season builder and AI illustrations. Paste any key: BIZSIM recognises the provider, checks which models really answer and adds them to your fallback chain.
